name: Detective Romppainen
source: Cities Without Number: Character Creation (attributes, background, skills, Edges, Foci, equipment), Rules of the Game (saves, checks), Gear (weapons and armour stat lines)
note: Every entry under "choices" is an undecided player option, not canon: the sheet lists what the slice needs to be playable and marks the rest as the player's. Attributes are 3-18, skills 0-4, and the two Armour Classes are CWN's melee and ranged values.

inventory.note: Encumbrance is CWN's Stowed/Readied capacity; this sheet lists the items the slice uses and does not compute a load total.
